TITLE: SoilGrids250m 2.0 - Clay content
DESCRIPTION: Clay content (0-2 micro meter) mass fraction in ‰ at 6 standard depths. Predictions were derived using a digital soil mapping approach based on Quantile Random Forest, drawing on a global compilation of soil profile data and environmental layers. To visualize these layers please use www.soilgrids.org.
SHORT_DESCRIPTION: Clay content in different depth intervals.
AUTHOR: Batjes NH, Ribeiro E, van Oostrum A
CITATION: Batjes NH, Ribeiro E, van Oostrum A (2020) Standardised soil profile data to support global mapping and modelling (WoSIS snapshot 2019)
COMMENT: The files are named: clay_5km_[depth], I used the mean clay content per depth interval. I downloaded the data in 5x5 km grid resolution via Google Earth Engine.
